The described data breach is severe due to the sensitive nature of the compromised information. The exposure of medical histories and treatment details violates patient privacy and can lead to discrimination or stigma. Additionally, the inclusion of health insurance details and patient names significantly increases the risk of identity theft and insurance fraud for the 200,000 affected individuals, as criminals can use this data to file false claims or assume identities for financial gain.
